description: The menu-button contract TmContextMenu hands to a host trigger in AsChild mode (TmContextMenu.AsChild = true). The wrapper is presentational then; the host's own trigger element (usually a native <button> inside the Trigger fragment) binds IsOpen to aria-expanded, declares aria-haspopup="menu" and calls ToggleAsync from its click handler. Activation keys are the native button contract — the menu adds no emulation.
